## Context
Research how agents can write concise but complete ticket descriptions, plans, and comments. Use current evidence and examples from popular, actively maintained OSS prompt, skill, or Claude-plugin projects.

## Plan
- Review 2025-2026 primary research on controllable verbosity, compression, and evaluation.
- Inspect maintained OSS agent-instruction repositories for concrete brevity patterns.
- Synthesize agent guidance and deterministic bloat signals with false-positive safeguards.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Cite at least three 2025-2026 primary sources and four maintained OSS sources.
- [ ] Distinguish empirical evidence from practitioner convention.
- [ ] Give actionable agent guidance that preserves necessary facts.
- [ ] For each proposed check, state its computable signal, default threshold, severity, and exemption.
- [ ] Identify checks that must remain advisory because they cannot prove irrelevance.

## Verification
Cross-check material claims against cited sources. Confirm the answer explicitly covers (1) agent-writing guidance and (2) deterministic rules for flagging bloated content.
